name: Crewe Foodbank
short_description: Part of The Trussell Trust network providing emergency food parcels. Based at St Thomas' Church. Open Mon and Thu for distribution. Referral required via local agencies.

description: Volunteer-run community garden within Victoria Park. Grows vegetables and soft fruits with harvest shared among volunteers. Open weekends during growing season.
